messages:
rachel_sales: Heads-up: Prospect 'CedarHealth' wants a concise benchmark and cost delta for a 48h POC. Baseline: 100 rps steady, short bursts 800 rps for 90s every 20m. They requested SAML + privatelink for trial. Can we lock a run plan + rough cost?
omar_perf: Proposed quick plan: warmup (15m @30%), steady (4h @100rps), burst cycles (90s @800rps every 20m for 6h), long soak (12h @80rps). Capture p50/p95/p99, batch hist, kv-cache hit.
jean_infra: Runner sample: ```rbench --model redwood-13b-q4 --target https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate --qps 100 --concurrency 40 --duration 14400 --burst-pattern "800@90s:every20m" --warmup 900``` I'll provision 4 x a100-sim nodes and a burst autoscaler.
lara_sec: Security minimal shareable: SAML 2.0 (IdP metadata), privatelink or VPC peering (provide IP ranges), KMS-backed keys. SOC2/ISO available. HSM = extra onboarding.
mike_ae: Cost ask: token estimate for full 48h run and monthly delta if they commit to reserved baseline at 100rps vs on-demand. Need slide text.
omar_perf: Token calc (est): avg 40 tokens/req. Tokens/hr = 100 * 40 * 3600 = 14.4M. For 48h ~691M tokens. At $0.00075/1k tokens => ~$518 run cost. Reserved baseline (monthly) would cut unit cost ~20%; bursts billed on-demand with small premium. Will make small table.
deploy-bot: [system] Sandbox provisioning scheduled: 4 x a100_sim allocated 2027-08-02 09:00 PT -> 2027-08-04 09:00 PT. Artifacts path: /shared/sales/cedarhealth/2123456789/
jean_infra: Metrics to capture: p50/p95/p99, queue_time_ms, batch_size_hist, gpu_util_pct, kv_cache_hit_pct, per-request token count. Also capture request IDs for any 5xxs.
omar_perf: Quick smoke in 30m, will post p95/p99. If p99 > 500ms during bursts, try increasing max_wait to 20ms and widening batch cap.
rachel_sales: Great, please paste the minimal security checklist snippet here I can send to procurement. Also include the 99% POC uptime SLA and fallback to smaller model after 3m sustained p95 breach.
lara_sec: Snippet: "We support SAML 2.0 (IdP metadata + ACS), privatelink or VPC peering (provide corporate IP range), KMS-managed keys. SOC2 & ISO27001 attestations available. HSM requires additional onboarding."
mike_ae: I'll draft the slide once you post smoke numbers and the cost sheet. Thanks everyone.
